description: Anytime A* is Gnad and Hoffmann's Anytime Fork-Root A* for decoupled search. There a task splits into a *center* and *leaves*, the search branches only over *global* actions (those not confined to one leaf), and each node keeps the *price* (cheapest cost) of every reachable leaf state. The open list is ordered by `g` plus a *root* heuristic, which estimates only the cost of the remaining global actions. A second, admissible heuristic over the whole remaining cost prunes every node that cannot beat the best solution found so far. The search stops when the open-list key plus the least possible leaf goal price reaches the best solution cost, and the plan is then optimal if both heuristics never overestimate what they estimate.

papers.title: Beating LM-Cut with h^max (Sometimes): Fork-Decoupled State Space Search
papers.venue: International Conference on Automated Planning and Scheduling (ICAPS)
